Head_and_Face: Head is medium-sized with a moderate skull and tapered muzzle.
Ears are medium-sized, triangular, erect, and set high.
Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and blue, brown, or one of each (heterochromia) with an alert, friendly expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is athletic, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline.
Coat is thick, double coat in various colors including black-and-white, grey-and-white, red-and-white, and solid white.
Coat is dense with a soft undercoat and straight outer guard hairs.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is bushy, fox-brush shaped, and carried over the back in a sickle curve.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and lean with a flat skull and strong muzzle.
Ears are set high, thin, and carried close to the head.
Eyes are medium-sized, round, and brown or blue with an intelligent, alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is well-proportioned, muscular, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline.
Coat is smooth, white, covered with black or brown (liver) spots.
Coat is short, dense, fine, and sleek with spots evenly distributed over the body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is long, tapering, and carried with a slight upward curve.

Head_and_Face: Head is round with a short muzzle and prominent chin, giving a monkey-like expression.

Eyes are dark, round, and prominent with a mischievous, alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact, square-proportioned, and sturdy.
Coat is dark, wiry, harsh in black, grey, silver, red, or black-and-tan.
Coat is wiry, rough-textured, and stands off from the body with a shaggy appearance around the head, notably short but dense enough to create a scruffy silhouette.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked short and carried high.

Head_and_Face: Head is finely wrinkled with a flat skull and tapered muzzle.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and massive with a short muzzle.
